implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA (VERIFIED by reading): apps/mobile/ios/fastlane/Fastfile:41 (`xcargs << "CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=#{options[:build_number]}"`) and :79-81 / :98-100 (`number = latest_testflight_build_number(...) + 1; build(build_number: number)`) chose the build number AFTER every gate had run and injected it into the archive, so the identity that was verified (manifest/pbxproj build 1) was never the identity uploaded; nothing read infra/release/release-manifest.json; apps/mobile/scripts/release-identity.mjs did not exist; docs/DISTRIBUTION.md:70 and :85 documented 'bumps the build number'. Round-1 breaks resolved: (1) every base Fastfile comment whose code survives is present verbatim (verified by diffing `git show 55d80326:…Fastfile | grep '#'` line-by-line against HEAD — only the 4-line `# Build number arrives as a build-settings override…` block is gone, together with the override it described; pinned by 35 `keeps the base comment` tests); (2) `--require-committed` now requires HEAD readable, every identity file `git ls-files --error-unmatch` tracked, and `git hash-object` of the working file == `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` — skip-worktree, assume-unchanged, gitignored, staged and index-dropped trees are refused, git-unavailable fails closed; (3) verify_archive_identity compares the archive's CFBundleVersion/CFBundleShortVersionString against `expected["buildNumber"].to_s`/`expected["marketingVersion"]` captured BEFORE build_app, then re-runs the script with `--require-committed --assert-version --assert-build --assert-git-sha <captured sha> --latest-uploaded <same bound>`; (4) build numbers are exact — manifest build must be a positive safe integer, `--assert-build` compares decimal strings, `--latest-uploaded` compares via BigInt; (5) every flag may appear once (`--assert-build 2 --assert-build 1` → exit 1 'given more than once'). Also: the script validates the plist each configuration's INFOPLIST_FILE really points at and requires MARKETING_VERSION/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION to be SET in every configuration of the single application target (a missing setting is refused, not just a differing one). Docs: DISTRIBUTION.md documents the two gates, preserves 'builds 1, 2 and 3 of version 1.0 … build 3 is the newest' and states the next build must be greater than 3 and is the owner's decision — this change does NOT pick it; the committed identity remains 1.0 (1) and the lanes would refuse to upload it. No PR opened; nothing pushed to main or ci/mac-*; no release/upload/ASC/Supabase/secret action performed. Two commits on devin/pp/w11-08/impl-r2: a1b27181 (regression suite) and cfdfb2e1 (implementation); head_sha cfdfb2e1dd4c4da35dc88ebb79390d87e256057a.

non_blocking_issues: apps/mobile/ios/fastlane/Fastfile:88 and :146 — both gates call `sh("node", script, *args, log: false)`. fastlane's sh_control_output appends the command output to the raised error only when print_command_output is true, so when release-identity.mjs refuses, the operator on the Mac sees only 'Shell command exited with exit status 1 instead of 0.' and NOT the script's stderr reason (e.g. 'committed build 1 is not greater than 3 …'). VERIFIED on Linux with the fastlane harness: 0 occurrences of the refusal text in the fastlane log for the latest_uploaded:3 and moved-sha cases, while the same script run directly prints it. Safety is unaffected (the lane still refuses, fail-closed) and docs/DISTRIBUTION.md tells the owner to run the script by hand, but the diagnostic should surface: e.g. pass an `error_callback: ->(out) { UI.error(out) }` (then user_error!) or `log: true` at gate 2 (gate 1 could keep log:false to avoid echoing JSON and print `output` in the error path). Suggested follow-up, not a blocker for this package's objective.
